label: 测试分选机
definition: Jinhaitong source-native 分产品 row 测试分选机: the issuer's whole test-handler product line across all series (EXCEED-6000/-8000/-9000, SUMMIT, COLLIE) and all applications. Carries the product revenue/cost/margin row, the 产销量 unit table and the product temperature envelope. No model, application, memory or HBM allocation.

label: 备品备件
definition: Jinhaitong source-native 分产品 row 备品备件: spare parts and consumables supplied with its handlers. Parts revenue, not equipment unit sales; not additive to handler unit counts.

label: 半导体设备制造
definition: Jinhaitong source-native 分行业 row 半导体设备制造, equal to 主营业务收入 and to the sum of the 测试分选机 and 备品备件 product rows. A presentation total, not an additional market subtotal, and smaller than company 营业收入, which also carries 其他业务收入.

label: EXCEED-9000 系列
definition: Jinhaitong EXCEED-9000 handler family. The FY2025 MD&A names it with the EXCEED-9800 and EXCEED-9032 sub-series (常高温大平台超多工位 handlers); the convertible-bond prospectus model table says its revenue includes EXCEED-9032 系列、EXCEED-9800 系列等产品. Two share bases exist and must not be mixed, separated by dimensions.revenue_basis: the FY2025 annual report gives a share of company 营业收入总额, and the prospectus gives absolute family revenue with a share of 主营业务收入. No unit count or margin is disclosed at this granularity.

label: 境内
definition: Jinhaitong source-native 分地区 row 境内 of the main-business table; the issuer's own domestic label, not resolved to customer country, and mixing handlers with spare parts.

label: 境外
definition: Jinhaitong source-native 分地区 row 境外 of the main-business table; countries are not resolved, although the narrative names 中国台湾, Southeast Asia, Europe and the Americas as markets.

label: EXCEED-6000 系列
definition: Jinhaitong handler revenue row EXCEED-6000 系列 in the prospectus and inquiry-reply model table; part of 测试分选机 revenue. No memory or HBM allocation.

label: EXCEED-8000 系列
definition: Jinhaitong handler revenue row EXCEED-8000 系列 in the prospectus and inquiry-reply model table; part of 测试分选机 revenue. No memory or HBM allocation.

label: 其他设备
definition: Jinhaitong handler revenue row 其他设备: the residual of the model table after the three EXCEED families. Not itemised, so SUMMIT, COLLIE, NEOCEED, EIGER and any Memory handler cannot be separated.

label: 其他业务
definition: Jinhaitong 其他业务 row of the revenue note, which the prospectus describes as lease, scrap and repair and relocation income. The residual between 主营业务 and company 营业收入.

label: 研发费用
definition: Jinhaitong income-statement line 研发费用 as printed in the H1 2026 科目变动分析表; the scope exists to identify the line for its printed year-on-year change.

label: 存货
definition: Jinhaitong 存货 row of the H1 2026 资产及负债状况 table, for its printed change against the prior year-end and share of total assets.

label: 合同资产
definition: Jinhaitong 合同资产 row of the H1 2026 资产及负债状况 table, for its printed change against the prior year-end and share of total assets.

label: 委外组装数量
definition: Jinhaitong count of handler machines assembled by outside contractors. Overlaps 产量 and is not additive to it: in H1 2026 the 544 exceeds both 产量 and 销量 because machines await in-house final tuning.

label: 马来西亚生产运营中心
definition: Jinhaitong Penang production and operations centre, used for its H1 2026 output and its stated current and full-ramp capacity. Output sits inside group 产量.

label: 上海租赁厂区
definition: Jinhaitong leased Shanghai plant, the main production site, with stated capacity of 30 台/月 or 360 台/年.

label: 上海澜博半导体设备制造中心建设项目
definition: Proposed Shanghai manufacturing project under the convertible bond: planned 340 台/年. Not built, and the bond was still under exchange review at the reply date.

label: 半导体测试设备智能制造及创新研发中心一期项目
definition: IPO-funded Tianjin project: planned 500 台/年 after a three-year ramp, mostly mature models. Expected to close in October 2026.

label: 现有产能小计
definition: Source subtotal of current capacity across the Shanghai leased site and Malaysia, about 420 台/年.

label: 现有生产基地在达产后的产能小计
definition: Source subtotal of existing and building sites at full ramp, excluding the convertible-bond project: 980 台/年.

label: 预计达产后的远期产能小计
definition: Source subtotal of long-run capacity after all projects, printed under two scenarios: 960 台/年 if the Shanghai lease moves into the new base, 1,320 台/年 if it stays.

label: 与本次募投项目对应的在手订单
definition: Subset of Jinhaitong order backlog that the issuer maps to convertible-bond project products. Overlaps total backlog and is not additive.

label: 马来西亚
definition: Malaysia row of the overseas revenue table; customer location, not end-use. A subset of 外销.

label: 泰国
definition: Thailand row of the overseas revenue table; customer location, not end-use. A subset of 外销.

label: 新加坡
definition: Singapore row of the overseas revenue table; customer location, not end-use. A subset of 外销.

label: 其他
definition: Residual 其他 row of the overseas revenue table; countries are not named. A subset of 外销.

label: 第一代半自动化 Memory 芯片测试分选机
definition: Specification rows for Jinhaitong's first semi-automated memory handler, from the 目前相关技术指标 row of the September 2026 inquiry reply. No revenue, unit, customer or HBM allocation.
